artifacts.synopsis: TE David Kniseley and others challenged Rocky Mountain Presbytery's approval of the public title “Minister of Church Life” for an unordained female staff member. The SJC denied the complaint, holding that “minister” has a specific technical meaning in the BCO but that the BCO is silent on generic titles for non-ordained staff, leaving that use to lower-court judgment subject to BCO 40-2(3); a dissent disagreed.

The commission sustained the principal specifications, annulled Presbytery's adoption of its judicial commission report, tried the matters de novo, and imposed censures on ministers and former ruling elders.

artifacts.title: Call of assistant pastor from another denomination without presbyterial examination

matches.evidence: A session may not call an ordained assistant pastor from another denomination without presbytery approval and examination, as all teaching elders must be members of the serving presbytery.
